description: A stationary round wooden outdoor table with radial tabletop boards, upright legs and diagonal/cross bracing on paved ground. A weathered brown vase holds a dry fan-shaped leaf at its center. A green-and-black ball rests beneath it. Grass, layered plants, brick walls, a dark door, and distant roof shapes surround the scene.
cameraIntent: Begin at the photographed view. Make a shallow lateral arc with a slight rise, showing table-leg/ball and table/background occlusion changes while keeping the table, vase and dry leaf inside the frame.
invariants: The table, vase, dry fan leaf and green ball remain rigidly stationary.
Preserve the round tabletop, radial wood divisions, supports and ball position.
Do not replace the dry fan leaf with a living plant or add people.

normalization.operation: EXIF orientation, centered uniform cover crop to exact aspect ratio; no stretching or generative editing
